mapper.select: /* GpsRetentionMapper.countExpiredAttdGps */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_USER_ATTD_GPS WHERE API_CALL_DATE < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{retentionMonths} MONTH), '%Y%m%d') AND (LAT IS NOT NULL OR LON IS NOT NULL OR LAT_ENC IS NOT NULL OR LON_ENC IS NOT NULL)
mapper.update: /* GpsRetentionMapper.purgeAttdGps */ UPDATE TB_USER_ATTD_GPS SET LAT = NULL , LON = NULL , LAT_ENC = NULL , LON_ENC = NULL /* S5: 파기 사유 기록 — 조회 화면이 "보존기간 경과 / 철회 / 원래 없음"을 구분하는 근거. */ , GPS_PURGE_REASON_CD = 'RETENTION' WHERE API_CALL_DATE < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{retentionMonths} MONTH), '%Y%m%d') AND (LAT IS NOT NULL OR LON IS NOT NULL OR LAT_ENC IS NOT NULL OR LON_ENC IS NOT NULL) LIMIT #{batchSize}
